title: Shakespeare in the Park: A Midsummer Night’s Dream
description: An evening of magic, mischief and live theater in the gardens, featuring performers from seven SDMC high schools. Enjoy Shakespeare’s A Midsummer Night’s Dream at Palma Sola Botanical Park. Drinks and snacks available for purchase.

title: Art in the Park with Kathy Peters
description: Meet artist Kathy Peters and enjoy her paper-quilling artwork. Free admission, with light bites and beverages; no RSVP needed to attend. An optional framed sand-turtle quilling workshop costs $25. Call Kathy at 315-368-3391 to reserve a workshop spot.

title: Winter Nights under the Lights
description: Acres of Lights, Santa & Mrs. Claus, Food Trucks, Gift Market, Hot Cider, Live Music, Decorated Trees, Crafts, Toys for Tots & More
